5. Diagnostics and Imaging

5.1 Laboratory Medicine

Common tests: - Complete blood count (CBC) - Basic metabolic panel
(BMP) - Liver function tests (LFTs)

Interpretation requires clinical correlation.

5.2 Imaging Modalities

-   X-ray
-   CT scan
-   MRI
-   Ultrasound
-   PET scan

Each modality has strengths and limitations.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

metadata.document_summary: This diagnostic report provides detailed findings from laboratory tests and imaging studies, aimed at diagnosing potential medical conditions. It is intended for use by healthcare professionals to guide patient treatment plans.
